pages.text: I have been investing for years and this is my take. I want to talk about Treasury bills today. Take a patient long-term view and hold on. Reinvest your earnings every year and let time do the work. Once you buy a Treasury bill your money is locked and it cannot be sold until it matures.

Treasury bills are short-term government securities issued at a discount and redeemed at face value. Bills are sold at regular auctions and can be bid for through a bank, a broker or the central bank's online platform. This is only my opinion and you must decide for yourself.
